items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Not Duke's band, but the Basie band

ctx.x: Not Duke's band, but the Basie band, but he couldn't do it for the reverse reason that they couldn't take that black band through the South with a white lead alto player. They might have a white fourth trumpet player and get by with it, but they couldn't have a white lead alto player, so he lost his Basie gig.
That's weird. How can anybody tell that the white guy is playing lead?
